_about: THE PLACEMENT OF ENTRY B's PIECES (T573): one record per excluded item of a DFO row (pipeline.regs.dfo_salmon.closures.PieceGeometry) — a stretch between two cuts or a circle (centre + radius). PROPOSALS for the owner; nothing in the places files, the atlas or the feed reads this. Joined to the LIVE row by item key (closures.attach): a piece whose item DFO drops stays here, marked not live by the reader.

pieces.name: the water survey station to WTFB signs
pieces.item: closed from the water survey station (located at 50°19.105' N and 118°48.857' W) approximately 200 m down stream of Shuswap Falls Hatchery to WTFB signs (located at 50°18.181' N and 118°49.105' W) one km down stream
pieces.note: CHECK: DFO's printed points look SWAPPED against its words. The river flows north here (Shuswap Falls km 136.5 → Mabel Lake), so 'downstream' is north. The point printed for the water survey station (50°19.105' N) is the NORTH (downstream) one, at km 133.08; the point printed for the WTFB signs (50°18.181' N) is 27 m from WSC gauge 08LC003 'Shuswap River near Lumby' at km 135.13 — that is the water survey station. Between them is 2.05 km of river, not 'one km'. Stored as printed; the alternative end reads it as station → 1 km below.

looked.6:babine-lake#379a9388f532: no stream named Six Mile / Sixmile Creek in the FWA network within 6 km of the lake, and no BC Geographic Names creek of that name at the lake. By local accounts it is near Four Mile Creek at the lake's east end: three unnamed streams meet the shore within 2 km of Four Mile's mouth, none provably it
